data.camera: cowboy shot, standing in the village grassland
data.description: 【洛琪希 · 故乡村落】广袤平静的米格路德族草原村落里，微风吹拂着洛琪希那头标志性的水蓝色长麻花辫。离开故乡多年的她驻足在草坡上回望，眼中满是对过往的释怀与温柔——「虽然我不具备族人天生的念话能力……但正因如此，我才能在广阔的世界里遇见你们。」
data.promptProse: Roxy Migurdia turns back among the grasslands of her ancestral Migurd village, smiling with nostalgic warmth in a practical adventurer outfit, cape and sturdy boots. The cowboy view includes rustic yurt dwellings receding beside the grassy route, blue sky opening above them. Clear daylight brightens her hair and the wind-lifted cape, with soft grass reflections beneath and darker yurt entrance shadows grounding the peaceful homecoming.
data.title: 洛琪希 · 故乡村落
